about: The Roblox-style lobby floating at match.hubY over spawn (creator: things to do while the next island is made, kept clean and tidy: plain grey floor, each activity in its own purple-and-blue bordered zone with one small sign: a shooting range and the Sky Tower). shooting_range: facing = the way you shoot; a light-blue firing line on the near side (stand there for a practice rifle with endless ammo), a black back wall on the far side where targets pop up (width = across, along the back wall; height = from the firing line to the back wall). Where it reaches past the hub's floor it lays its own (creator: on a deck off the hub's west edge, by the obby). tower_obby: a quartz pillar with purple and blue platforms spiralling up to a gold top, height = top in blocks. Coordinates relative to (0, hubY, 0). facing: the direction the piece's front looks. No cinematics in the hub (creator request); music is the mod's own looping hub track (sounds/music/hub_loop.ogg). text_board: a black board with big readable text in front (label; ' | ' starts a new line). The leaderboard board shows its label as the title and header; the game writes the top 10 under it: this room (world) only, everyone who has played a match in it, never a worldwide board (creator). rarity_board / heals_board: boards filled from the rarities and consumables sheets, one row per entry with the item's picture beside it (label: title | line above the rows | notes under them).

rows.label: MINEBLOX ROYALE | 1. All stand on one portal: Solo/Duos/Trios/Squads | 2. Ride the Battle Bus - SPACE jumps out | 3. SPACE while skydiving opens your glider | 4. Loot chests for guns, heals, shields and ammo | 5. Stay inside the storm circle - the purple hurts | 6. Teams: revive (hold F), reboot cards at vans | 7. Last one (or team) standing wins!
GUN RARITY | Better rarity = more damage, faster reloads | Mythic guns are only in the rare blue chests | Walk over a better copy of your gun to swap | The stripe on each gun shows its rarity
HEALS & SHIELDS | Hold right mouse to use | Most you can have: 100 health, 100 shield | Mini Shields: 2 until your shield breaks | Slurp Juice: again at 25 shield or less

CONTROLS | Left mouse: shoot / swing | Right mouse: aim, drink, heal | R: reload    G: build mode | TAB: map + waypoint | B: emotes   K: locker   Q: drop | F (hold): search chests, revive, reboot | Pickaxe: trees, walls, cars = materials

COMMANDS | /rc or /roomcode: this room's code | /rc <code>: join a friend's room | /leave: back to your own world | /party invite <name>: ask to team up | /party accept: join after an invite | /party leave: leave your party | /party: who's in your party | Parties: up to 4, same room only | Your party = your team in team modes | Party not full? Bots fill the empty spots
